description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.enm.

entries.description: Ordered internal-name and file-name pairs extracted from the nested serializeData dictionary.
entries.title: Filename map entries
entries.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep entries unique, lower-case both names as the game does, and preserve order when round-tripping an existing file.
entries.x-meido-game-usage: The exporter resolves internal names and file names through this map when writing bridge resources.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The exporter loads export_map.enm, stores a lower-case internal-name to file-name dictionary, and serializes the dictionary as a nested JSON string in serializeData.

format.description: The marker for the normalized filename-map representation.
format.title: Editing format marker
format.x-meido-game-usage: This is an editing-layer value; native JsonUtility stores version and serializeData instead.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The exporter loads export_map.enm, stores a lower-case internal-name to file-name dictionary, and serializes the dictionary as a nested JSON string in serializeData.

nativeDecodeError.description: A diagnostic captured when the native wrapper or nested dictionary could not be fully normalized.
nativeDecodeError.title: Native decode diagnostic
nativeDecodeError.x-meido-edit-guidance: Do not turn this diagnostic into a resource-map entry.
nativeDecodeError.x-meido-game-usage: The game has no field with this name; it is an editing-layer explanation of a partially decoded file.

nativeText.description: The original JsonUtility document retained for byte-preserving output when entries are unchanged.
nativeText.title: Original native JSON
nativeText.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it when no semantic edit is made; allow the writer to regenerate it after changing entries.
nativeText.x-meido-game-usage: The game consumes the native wrapper, not this editing-only copy.

version.title: Name-map version
version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the source value and use 1000 for KCES 1.34.4 output.
version.x-meido-game-usage: ExportFileNameMap uses the version-control base class while loading and saving export_map.enm.
